Method of Attack: Extortion scam claiming installation of Remote Access Trojan (RAT) via EternalBlue exploit
Scammers claim RAT records videos via front camera and steals contacts and passwords
Demand ransom payment of $600 in Bitcoin to prevent sending videos to contacts
Indicators of Compromise: Extortion email with subject 'Security Alert. Your account was compromised. Password must be changed'
Emails containing publicly disclosed passwords from data breaches
